title: [MCP] Add company and environment descriptions
summary: Company and environment descriptions are now stored and exposed via APIs to provide richer context for MCP and other consumers. Company descriptions are stored as BLOBs in Company Information, environment descriptions once per database in System Application, and both are made available as read-only fields in API v2.0.
key_points: Company Description field added to Company Information table as a BLOB across all country layers
Environment Description stored once per database in System Application
Multiline text editors added to Company Information page UI
Read-only fields exposed in API v2.0 companyInformation endpoint
API change is additive and backward compatible; existing APIs unchanged
quote: Add long-form descriptions for companies and environments so MCP and other API consumers can retrieve richer context.
